title: CVNSS4.0 as an Experimental Orthographic-Audit Writing Model for Vietnamese: Vowel Transformation, Jesuit Missionary Linguistics, and Domain-Specific AI/NLP/LLM Infrastructure
abstract: This preprint proposes CVNSS4.0 as an experimental orthographic-audit writing model for Vietnamese, not as a replacement for Quốc Ngữ. It frames CVNSS4.0 as a machine-readable intermediate representation that decomposes Vietnamese syllables into onset, rhyme/nucleus, coda, tone, and audit metadata; then situates the model within a broader history of missionary linguistics, writing-system typology, and domain-specific AI/NLP/LLM infrastructure.
